name: Real Signal
description: Calm, source-attributed neighbourhood intelligence for AI assistants.

auth.notes: Public MCP reads are unauthenticated and rate-limited; benchmark submission is append-only and must be reviewed separately.

review_prompts: Which neighbourhoods does Real Signal currently observe?
What has Cluny Court's weekly rhythm looked like recently? Cite the report and timestamp it.
Is there a confirmed experience worth discovering near Cluny Court right now? Explain an empty result honestly.
Separate strict high-confidence prediction accuracy from raw exploratory accuracy and report insufficient-data states explicitly.

_finalization.note: Publisher fields resolved from committed repo/config; github_repository_url stays blocked_by_owner_identity because the repo is not yet created (the packet's stated blocker). Nothing invented. Added below: verification evidence + the runtime contracts the packet requires (tasks 3-6). NOT PUBLISHED, NOT SUBMITTED.

rules: sample.n null is never coerced to 0
synthetic/confidence-gated readings are never reported as live

accuracy_guardrail.strict_high_confidence: confidence >= 0.68 AND substrate_completeness >= 0.75; own denominator; 'unavailable or insufficiently supported' (null, never 0) when no eligible rows
accuracy_guardrail.raw_exploratory: all revealed graded rows incl. low-confidence forecasts; separate number + denominator
